page.overview:
Who is Naga Sadow?

Naga Sadow was an ancient Sith Lord and Sith alchemist who, according to the quasi-historical Qel-Droma Epics, led the Sith Empire during the Great Hyperspace War against Empress Teta and the Jedi Order while also triggering the Cron Supernova. The Massassi of Yavin 4 allegedly built the Great Temple under Sadow's leadership in circa 5000 BBY in his honor, despite his poor treatment of the Massassi. Sadow's legacy continued on with his alchemy when scrolls belonging to him and others were used by Vaneé, an aide to Darth Vader, as well as his likeness being chiseled into the rock walls of the Sith Citadel on the Sith planet Exegol. First Order Supreme Leader Kylo Ren heard Sadow's voice among the unintelligible whispers of several Sith Lords while confronting the resurrected Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious on Exegol in 35 ABY.

The Great Temple on the moon Yavin 4 was alleged to have been built by Massassi warriors under Sadow's leadership around 5000 BBY. The Massassi admired Sadow as a god despite his poor treatment of them, and the Temple was raised in Sadow's honor. Archeologists later proposed that the Great Temple may have functioned as a large-scale communications device to contact other Sith Lords throughout the galaxy.

Sometime between 1 BBY and 4 ABY during the reign of the Galactic Empire under Galactic Emperor Darth Sidious and Darth Vader, scrolls that belonged to Sadow and other Sith alchemists such as Dathka Graush and Darth Betrius were collected at Fortress Vader on the volcanic planet Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At this time, Vader's aide Vaneé used the scrolls to further develop a procedure by Imperial scientist Dr. Harper, which involved implanting parts of a droid brain into an organic being to force them into becoming an obedient spy for the Empire.

Naga Sadow numbered among several Sith Lords whose likenesses were chiseled into the rock walls of the Sith Citadel on the hidden Sith planet Exegol, located in the Unknown Regions. which was named in honor of the Sith Lord. When the Supreme Leader of the First Order and master of the Knights of Ren, Kylo Ren, arrived on Exegol to confront the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, he maneuvered through the Sith Citadel and recognized from his studies the rock statues of Sadow and some of the other Sith Lords. Ren also heard their unintelligible whispers.
